modules.title: Mutual Fund Basics
modules.subtitle: What a fund is and how it works

cards.title: Many investors, one pool
cards.body: A mutual fund collects money from many investors and invests it together.

questions.explanation: NAV is the per-unit value of a fund.
Past performance does not guarantee future returns.
Many funds accept SIPs of a few hundred rupees.

payload.statement: You need a lot of money to start investing in mutual funds.
